channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Haiti police say 34 gang members killed in capital raid
item.description: Haitian police say at least 34 gang members were killed in an operation in the capital city of Port-au-Prince.

item.title: Iran war live: Houthis escalate attacks on Saudi capital
item.description: Houthi missile fire has rocked Riyadh's financial centre as the Iran war leaves 'lasting marks' on global energy.

item.title: Six killed in suspected gas explosion at Georgia apartment building
item.description: Georgian Interior Minister Sulkhan Tamazashvili said rescuers had recovered six bodies from the wreckage.

item.title: Haiti police say at least 34 suspected gang members killed in raid
item.description: Police say the raid targeted the Martissant area, located on a key route out of Port-au-Prince held by gangs since 2021.

item.title: Ten killed in Pakistan as bus crashes into gas tanker
item.description: Ten people were killed and at least 27 more injured after a passenger bus collided with an LPG tanker in Pakistan.

item.title: Senate Republicans in US reject measure to limit Trump’s war powers in Iran
item.description: The resolution was defeated 51-48. Three Republicans broke rank, voting for the measure.

item.title: 'I tell my son it's just fireworks': People inside besieged Yemeni city speak to BBC
item.description: Orla Guerin speaks to seven people trapped in Taiz by the Houthis who reveal what life is like under siege.

item.title: Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya minority, top UN court rules
item.description: The unprecedented International Court of Justice verdict concerns a 2017 military crackdown that killed thousands.

item.title: Israeli military completes ground operation in Gaza beyond Yellow Line
item.description: Hamas condemned the incursion, which the Israeli military said was to dismantle a "terror tunnel", as a "flagrant" ceasefire violation.

item.title: Kuwait says it repelled first Iranian attack in two months after US strikes island
item.description: Bahrain says it was also attacked by Iran following a US air strike on the Iranian island of Qeshm in the Gulf on Tuesday.
